title: Unlabelled Document Outline
description: A content-blind document description, global themes, and a flat ordered outline of substantive, rhetorical, and structural commitments.

document_description.description: A non-empty, content-blind description of the document's specific type, venue, audience, and register.

global_themes.description: One substantive sentence for each genuinely distinct global theme.

items.description: A flat list of outline items in document order. IDs must be consecutive integers beginning with 1.

id.description: The item's position in the outline. IDs must be consecutive integers beginning with 1.

content.description: A concise, source-independent statement of one substantive, rhetorical, or structural commitment, normally one sentence and no more than 60 words.

verbatim.description: True only when the content intentionally preserves source wording whose exact form is substantive.
